name: After recital P
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: Pa. whereas in international relations theory, the ‘security dilemma’ refers to a phenomenon whereby actions, such as arms procurement, taken by a state actor to increase its own security provokes reactions from other states, such as increased arms procurement or preventive attacks, that ultimately lead to a decrease rather than an increase in the original state’s security;
